accepted_after_rework_attempt1_with_infr.meaning: One owner-worker re-review eventually passed after transient Codex/API/process retry noise.

accepted_after_rework_multi_attempt.meaning: More than one bounded rework attempt was needed before strict gates passed.

accepted_after_rework_multi_attempt_with.meaning: Multiple rework attempts plus transient infra retries were needed before strict gates passed.

accepted_clean_initial_gate_pass.meaning: Strict gates already passed before owner-worker rework.

blocked_parser_gap_activity_table.meaning: Activity/toxicity rows are present or expected but unsafe under current parser/table handling.

blocked_process_timeout_1800s_retryable.meaning: Owner-worker hit the 1800s watchdog; this is retryable and not proof that material is absent.

blocked_process_timeout_retryable.meaning: Owner-worker hit the configured watchdog; this is retryable and not proof that material is absent.

blocked_quality_gate_rework_cap_unresolv.meaning: Strict gates remained blocked after the bounded obtainable-only rework cap.

blocked_source_gap_figure_chart_exact_va.meaning: Remaining exact values are figure/chart-only or not safely promotable from local structured material.

blocked_source_gap_missing_external_supp.meaning: A specific supplementary source/table is absent or only present as a non-data placeholder.

infrastructure_initial_queue_failed.meaning: Initial workflow/bootstrap failed before owner-worker review could run.

infrastructure_retry_exhausted_api_or_ne.meaning: Codex/API/network-like failures exhausted the configured infra retry cap.

infrastructure_retry_exhausted_mixed.meaning: Multiple infrastructure failure families exhausted the configured retry cap.

infrastructure_retry_exhausted_paper_run.meaning: Per-paper controller/runtime exceptions exhausted the configured retry cap.

infrastructure_retry_exhausted_worker_in.meaning: Codex worker interruption exhausted the configured infra retry cap.

infrastructure_retry_exhausted_worker_no.meaning: Codex worker exited non-zero until the configured infra retry cap was exhausted.

unclassified_queue_status.meaning: No refined rule matched this queue result.
